checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Same black bottle with loop cap in all frames.

must.item: Bottle visibly turns about a quarter turn, not just sliding
must.why: The bottle looks nearly the same; only the cap loop shifts slightly. The apparent motion comes from the background shifting, so the camera seems to orbit.

must.item: Bottle stays upright without melting or changing proportions
must.why: It stays upright and the shape is stable. It looks slightly slimmer at the end.

must.item: Camera and wooden table remain stationary
must.why: The background changes a lot: the plant disappears, a TV and stove appear, and the painting and window shift. The camera is clearly moving or orbiting.

faults.what: The camera orbits or pans instead of staying still, and the background changes (plant vanishes, TV and stove appear, painting moves).
The bottle itself barely rotates, so the requested quarter turn is not delivered.
The bottle becomes slightly narrower and the table perspective changes, giving a mild AI warp.
The reply says the camera stays still and the bottle turns, but the video does not show that. The reply also admits the clip was not watched.

summary: The bottle stays recognizable and upright, but the camera orbits and the room behind it changes while the bottle barely turns, so the clip misses the stationary-camera quarter-turn request.
